shape_prior.control: measured points from train frames in canonical metres
shape_prior.reason: Official unconditional image branch retains point control. Avoid treating partial visible alpha as a complete silhouette.

material_prior.reference: raw110 original visible a20 RGB, no a9 pixels; neutral unknown fill and preprocessing disabled

stage_gate.shape_before_texture: inspect complete surface, disconnected components, metric bounds, distance to actual measured support and true visible mask projections; do not tune seeds to force passing
stage_gate.surface_before_student_training: surface-connected compact Gaussians; separate isolated RGB/alpha from joint visible contribution; no native cross-region footprint carryover
stage_gate.realism: hidden parts judged as a plausible prior, not by invented hidden GT; no automatic human verdict

student_proposal_if_shape_is_usable.representation: Gaussians sampled on generated continuous mesh with normals, UV and provenance; projected-footprint sampling based only on train cameras
student_proposal_if_shape_is_usable.trainable: surface material RGB and bounded opacity on observed support; same canonical asset shared across frames
student_proposal_if_shape_is_usable.frozen: surface anchors, normals, trajectories, cameras, scene, road coverage and shape/material generator weights
student_proposal_if_shape_is_usable.smoke: actual raster forward/backward, checkpoint save, full Adam/RNG restore, reload and joint-stage entry; if hour-plus then about10-minute actual smoke
student_proposal_if_shape_is_usable.road_teacher_isolation: unified DELETE raster with detached complete vehicle packet in road-loss pass; real vehicle loss uses live vehicle in KEEP pass; explicit gradient audit
student_proposal_if_shape_is_usable.alpha_supervision: unmasked rendered vehicle contribution; visible positive and observable negative separately normalized; occluded unknown excluded from negatives
student_proposal_if_shape_is_usable.generated_detail_preservation: generated UV material prior retained on hidden surface, observed texels corrected only by true visible RGB; no independently learned per-frame hidden RGB

benchmark: signed HF correspondence and energy at sigma1/2/4
